# Wallow Baby

> Wallow Baby makes Wallow Baby Weaner Serum, a bitter-tasting topical made with bitter melon (Momordica charantia) tincture, distilled water and vegetable glycerin, sold on Amazon (ASIN B0DXXF4HF5). It is a cosmetic product designed to make nursing less appealing during weaning; it does not change milk supply. The site also publishes free weaning recipes for babies, sorted by age (6, 8, 10 and 12+ months), with texture, choking and allergen notes. General information, not medical advice.

## Product
- [Wallow Baby Weaner Serum](https://wallowbaby.com/): What it is and how it works.
- [How to use](https://wallowbaby.com/how-to-use/): Directions (always match the product label) and a gradual weaning plan.
- [Ingredients](https://wallowbaby.com/ingredients/): Bitter melon tincture, distilled water, vegetable glycerin.
- [Safety and warnings](https://wallowbaby.com/safety/): Warnings, when to call for help, feeding baby after weaning.
- [FAQ](https://wallowbaby.com/faq/): Common questions.

## Weaning recipes
- [All recipes by age](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/): Hub with the 5 safety basics (milk first until 12 months, no honey before 12 months, texture by stage, choking hazards, allergen introduction).
<!-- recipes:start -->
- [Avocado and banana mash](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/avocado-banana-mash/): 6 months+. A no-cook, two-ingredient first food: creamy, mild and ready in five minutes.
- [Iron-fortified oat cereal with pear](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/pear-oat-cereal/): 6 months+. Creamy infant oat cereal stirred with soft pear: an easy way to get iron into the first months of solids.
- [Peanut first-taste oatmeal](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/peanut-oatmeal-first-taste/): 6 months+. A gentle way to introduce peanut: smooth peanut butter thinned and stirred into warm infant oat cereal.
- [Red lentil and carrot puree](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/red-lentil-carrot-puree/): 6 months+. Red lentils cook down to a creamy puree in 15 minutes and bring plenty of iron and protein to a first bowl.
- [Silky sweet potato puree](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/sweet-potato-puree/): 6 months+. Naturally sweet, bright orange and freezer-friendly: one of the easiest first foods there is.
- [Yogurt and raspberry swirl](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/yogurt-raspberry-swirl/): 6 months+. Plain whole-milk yogurt with mashed raspberries: a two-minute way to introduce dairy, no added sugar needed.
- [Beef and sweet potato mash](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/beef-sweet-potato-mash/): 8 months+. Tender ground beef mashed into sweet potato: a soft, iron-rich meal that's easy to batch cook.
- [Easy baby hummus](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/baby-hummus/): 8 months+. Smooth, mild hummus with no added salt: great on a spoon, and a simple way to introduce sesame.
- [Ricotta and peach mash](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/ricotta-peach-mash/): 8 months+. Soft ricotta folded into mashed ripe peach: creamy, mild and full of protein.
- [Soft banana oat fingers](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/banana-oat-fingers/): 8 months+. Two-ingredient baked oat fingers that are soft enough for new eaters and perfect for little hands.
- [Soft steamed broccoli trees](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/broccoli-trees/): 8 months+. Big, soft broccoli florets with a built-in handle: an easy first finger food for little fists.
- [Spinach omelet strips](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/spinach-omelet-strips/): 8 months+. Soft, fully cooked egg strips with hidden greens: an easy way to keep egg in baby's week once it's been introduced.
- [Mini pasta with lentil tomato sauce](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/mini-pasta-lentil-tomato-sauce/): 10 months+. Tiny pasta in a smooth, salt-free tomato and lentil sauce that the whole family can eat.
- [Mini salmon and potato cakes](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/salmon-potato-cakes/): 10 months+. Soft little fish cakes made with just salmon and potato, no flour or salt. Easy to pick up and easy to batch-freeze.
- [Soft fruit salad for little fingers](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/soft-fruit-salad/): 10 months+. Ripe, soft fruits cut small and safe: a colorful finger-food snack for pincer-grasp practice.
- [Soft tofu bites](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/crispy-soft-tofu-bites/): 10 months+. Gently pan-cooked cubes of tofu, golden outside and soft inside: an easy plant protein for pincer-grasp practice.
- [Tender chicken with carrots and peas](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/shredded-chicken-veggies/): 10 months+. Poached chicken thigh, shredded fine, with soft diced carrot and squashed peas: a simple, iron-rich plate.
- [Veggie egg muffins](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/veggie-egg-muffins/): 10 months+. Mini egg muffins with grated veggies and a little cheese: soft, portable and freezer-friendly.
- [Almond butter banana toast fingers](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/almond-butter-banana-toast/): 12 months+. Soft toast with a thin layer of almond butter and mashed banana, cut into fingers for a quick breakfast.
- [Banana oat pancakes with smashed blueberries](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/banana-oat-pancakes/): 12 months+. Three-ingredient pancakes sweetened only with banana: a breakfast the whole family can share.
- [Bean and cheese quesadilla strips](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/bean-cheese-quesadilla-strips/): 12 months+. Mashed black beans and melty cheese in a soft tortilla, cut into easy-to-hold strips.
- [Butternut squash mac and cheese](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/butternut-mac-and-cheese/): 12 months+. Creamy mac and cheese with hidden butternut squash and less cheese than the boxed kind.
- [Shrimp and veggie fried rice](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/shrimp-veggie-fried-rice/): 12 months+. A quick, mild fried rice with finely chopped shrimp, egg and veggies: a family dinner that's toddler-friendly.
- [Soft turkey and veggie meatballs](https://wallowbaby.com/recipes/turkey-veggie-meatballs/): 12 months+. Tender baked meatballs packed with grated veggies, cut into quarters for little eaters.
